Since the visualization includes bus stops that are outside of Singapore, we should combine both geometry data and data points using st_joins.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
busStop_in_SG <- st_join(
  busStop, mpsz, 
  join = st_within, 
  left=FALSE)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tm_shape(mpsz) + tm_polygons(col = "lightgrey", border.col = "white") + tm_shape(busStop_in_SG) + tm_dots(ol="red", size = 0.1)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


Next, we'll create grid layer and take hexagon with bus stops and exclude those areas without bus stop (either grid square or hexagon, or even traingle, etc)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon <- st_make_grid(mpsz, cellsize = 700, # diameter is 700 from center to edge
                        what = "polygon", # returns hexagon layer
                        square = FALSE) %>%
  st_sf() # make large sfc_polygon data into sf tabular (list) dataframe
```
:::


Since the hexagon table only have 1 column which is the polygon data, we need to assign id to each hexagon to know which it is.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon$n_collisions = #return true or false if hexagon intersect the bus stop
  lengths(st_intersects(hexagon, busStop_in_SG))

hexagon <- filter(hexagon, n_collisions > 0) # filter to only store hexagons that has bus stop
```
:::


::: callout-note
-   `hexagon$n_collisions` returns if hexagon intersects the bus stop

-   `lengths(st_intersects(hexagon, busStop_in_SG))` : st_intersections return output of geomteric cut, while this function return true or false (in numerical value; 0 means none or values \> 1 meaning the total number of bus stops within the hexagon),

-   `filter(hexagon, n_collisions > 0)` : filter to only store hexagons that has bus stop
:::


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon <- hexagon %>%
  select(, -n_collisions)

hexagon$HEX_ID <- sprintf(
  "H%04d", seq_len(nrow(hexagon))) %>% # start with 0
  as.factor() #ordinal scale

kable(head(hexagon))
```

## Preparing Trip Generation Data

### Cleaning Data


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
trips <- odbus %>%
  select(c(ORIGIN_PT_CODE, DAY_TYPE, TIME_PER_HOUR, TOTAL_TRIPS)) %>%
  rename(BUS_STOP_N = ORIGIN_PT_CODE) %>%
  rename(HOUR_OF_DAY = TIME_PER_HOUR) %>%
  rename(TRIPS = TOTAL_TRIPS)
trips$BUS_STOP_N <- as.factor(trips$BUS_STOP_N) # so that it cannot be converted accidentally to numerical column
kable(head(trips))
```

  busStop, hexagon) %>%
   st_drop_geometry() %>% #geometry will be replaced with hexagon 
  select(c(BUS_STOP_N, HEX_ID))
